svg.title: Defect theta and z
svg.desc: Two views of one cell with three defects. Left, a top view with x to the right, y up and z out of the page: the cell's outline is a gray circle with a blue notch at tag 1 (a dent, about -1.0 rad, below and right of center), a narrower blue notch at tag 2 (a scratch, about 1.3 rad, upper side) and a red bump at tag 3 (a bulge, about -2.3 rad, lower left). Tag 4 marks an arc from the +x axis clockwise to the dent's direction: theta, negative here. Tag 6 marks the +x axis, the direction of travel. Right, a side view from -y with x to the right and z up: a gray rectangle on a gray belt. The dent (tag 1) is a blue oval low on the right, the bulge (tag 3) a red oval high on the left, and the scratch (tag 2), on the far side, a dashed blue outline in the middle. Tag 5 marks an arrow from the cell's base up to the dent's center: z.
